narration: Your company hid a money machine inside your benefits portal. It guarantees a 17% return with zero risk. And four in ten workers have never turned it on.
visual: Smartphone showing HR benefits portal — Health, 401k, Dental all enrolled, but ESPP row glowing red with 'NOT ENROLLED'. A red badge in corner shows '40% skip it'.

narration: It's called an ESPP — Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You set aside part of your paycheck, and your company buys you stock at a 15% discount. That's literally all there is to it.
visual: Money bag with '$6,000 YOUR MONEY' on the left, arrow pointing right to a stock certificate labeled '$7,059 COMPANY STOCK' with a bright red 15% OFF badge.

narration: Here's the math: you pay 85 cents for every dollar of stock. Sell it immediately and you've made 17.6 cents profit. That return is locked in before the market even opens.
visual: Large '85¢' coin on left, animated arrow, '$1.00' coin on right. Below: '+17.6% GUARANTEED' badge. Three comparison bars: Savings 0.05%, S&P avg 10%, ESPP 17.6%.

narration: It gets even better. Most plans include a lookback provision. Stock went up? You buy at the original lower price. Stock went down? You still get 15% off today's price. You win either way.
visual: Stock chart splits into two paths — green arrow going up, red going down. Both paths end with green checkmarks and 'YOU WIN'. Text shows both discount scenarios.

narration: Number five: four in ten eligible workers never enroll. On a sixty-thousand-dollar salary contributing just ten percent, that's over a thousand dollars in free profit left on the table every year.
visual: Ten person silhouettes in a grid — six green with checkmarks, four gray with red X marks labeled 'SKIP'. Below: '$6,000 in → $7,059 out = $1,059 FREE' calculation.

narration: Open your HR portal and search for ESPP in your benefits. Enrolling takes fifteen minutes. That fifteen minutes could pay you over a thousand dollars a year — free money that's already yours.
visual: Smartphone showing ESPP enrollment form with green 'ENROLL NOW' button, big checkmark appearing. CTA card: 'FREE MONEY IS WAITING — GO CLAIM IT TODAY'.
